evidence_clock_rule: Only events with event_start_utc strictly after preregistration_timestamp_utc may contribute prospective evidence.
prediction_capture_rule: prediction_captured_at_utc must be strictly after preregistration_timestamp_utc and strictly before event_start_utc.
decision_market_rule: decision_quote_captured_at_utc must be strictly after preregistration_timestamp_utc and strictly before event_start_utc. Decision and close must refer to the same event, market, selection, threshold, and book.
close_market_rule: close_quote_captured_at_utc must be strictly after decision_quote_captured_at_utc and strictly before event_start_utc.
outcome_rule: final_outcome_observed_at_utc must be at or after event_start_utc and may never alter a previously frozen prediction or market quote.
provenance_rule: Prediction, decision quote, close quote, and final result must each carry immutable SHA-256 provenance. Synthetic, reconstructed, inferred, or retroactively backfilled pregame evidence is forbidden.
identity_rule: Every row must bind exact candidate_id, preregistration_commit_sha, candidate_code_git_sha, event_id, market, selection, threshold, and book.
historical_data_role: Historical 2016-2025 evidence may be used only as diagnostic/development evidence and may not be represented as a pristine final holdout.
notes: This policy exists because 2019 had already been contacted before a later policy described it as untouched. V2F final validation must therefore be prospective-only.
